title: ADA House of Delegates approves no dues increase for 2027
html:
The ADA House of Delegates voted Oct. 13 not to change active member dues for 2027.

Effective Jan. 1, 2027, ADA active member dues will be $627. The ADA Board of Trustees had recommended no dues increase.

Pursuant to the ADA Bylaws, the dues of active members shall be established by the House of Delegates as the last item of business at each annual session. The resolution to establish the dues of active members for the following year shall be proposed at each annual session by the Board of Trustees. The dues resolution may be amended to any amount by the House and requires a 60% affirmative vote for adoption, according to the ADA Bylaws, Chapter XII, Section 50.

The House met Oct. 10-13 in Indianapolis.
